defs.d: An item of furniture used to sit on or in, comprising a seat, legs, back, and sometimes arm rests, for use by one person. Compare stool, couch, sofa, settee, loveseat and bench.
defs.ex: All I need to weather a snowstorm is hot coffee, a warm fire, a good book and a comfortable chair.

defs.d: The seating position of a particular musician in an orchestra.
defs.ex: My violin teacher used to play first chair with the Boston Pops.

defs.d: To act as chairperson at; to preside over.
defs.ex: Bob will chair tomorrow's meeting.

defs.d: To carry in a seated position upon one's shoulders, especially in celebration or victory.
A chairman or chairwoman, someone who presides over a meeting, board, etc.

The conscious production or arrangement of sounds, colours, forms, movements, or other elements in a manner that affects the senses and emotions, usually specifically the production of the beautiful in a graphic or plastic medium.
defs.ex: There is a debate as to whether graffiti is art or vandalism.

defs.d: The creative and emotional expression of mental imagery, such as visual, auditory, social, etc.
To occupy fully, to take up all of.
To add contents to (a container, cavity or the like) so that it is full.
A person who studies or learns about a particular subject.
defs.ex: He is a student of life.

defs.d: A person who is formally enrolled at a school, a college or university, or another educational institution.
Sorrowfully.
With care; attentively, circumspectly.
defs.ex: As he was a politician, he discussed all subjects carefully, not offending anyone.  He carefully studied the papers, while planning his next move.  He carefully avoided the subject all evening.

defs.d: Full extent; distance between extreme limits; especially; the distance between the nearest surfaces of two bodies, or the space between walls.
defs.ex: a room ten feet square in the clear

defs.d: The completion of a stage or challenge, or of the whole game.
To remove obstructions, impediments or other unwanted items from.
defs.ex: If you clear the table, I'll wash up.

defs.d: To remove (items or material) so as to leave something unobstructed or open.
defs.ex: Please clear all this stuff off the table.

defs.d: Transparent in colour.
defs.ex: as clear as crystal

defs.d: Bright, not dark or obscured.
defs.ex: Congress passed the President’s Clear Skies legislation.

defs.d: A public house where beverages, primarily alcoholic, may be bought and consumed, also providing food and sometimes entertainment such as live music or television.
A public server.
To go to one or more public houses.
An act of recycling.
To break down and reuse component materials.
defs.ex: Both paper and plastic can be recycled.

defs.d: To reuse as a whole.
(authorship) One of the main sections into which the text of a book is divided.
defs.ex: Detective novel writers try to keep up the suspense until the last chapter.

defs.d: A section of a social or religious body.
To divide into chapters.
To put into a chapter.
Mental acceptance of a claim as true.
defs.ex: It's my belief that the thief is somebody known to us.

defs.d: Faith or trust in the reality of something; often based upon one's own reasoning, trust in a claim, desire of actuality, and/or evidence considered.
defs.ex: Based on this data, it is our belief that X does not occur.

defs.d: A person who edits or makes changes to documents.
A copy editor.
To roll or fold up; to wind round; to entwine.
To envelop completely; to surround; to cover; to hide.
defs.ex: to involve in darkness or obscurity

defs.d: Complicated.
defs.ex: He related an involved story about every ancestor since 1895.

defs.d: Associated with others, be a participant or make someone be a participant (in a crime, process, etc.)
defs.ex: He got involved in a bar fight.

defs.d: A needle without an eye (usually) made of drawn-out steel wire with one end sharpened and the other flattened or rounded into a head, used for fastening.
A small nail with a head and a sharp point.
(often followed by a preposition such as "to" or "on") To fasten or attach (something) with a pin.
(usually in the passive) To cause (a piece) to be in a pin.
Easily discovered, seen, or understood; self-explanatory.
A royal person; a member of a royal family.
A standard size of printing paper, measuring 25 by 20 inches.
Of or relating to a monarch or their family.
Having the air or demeanour of a monarch; illustrious; magnanimous; of more than common size or excellence.
A three dimensional work of art created by shaping malleable objects and letting them harden or by chipping away pieces from a rock (sculpting).
Works of art created by sculpting, as a group.
To fashion something into a three-dimensional figure.
To represent something in sculpture.
To make suitable; to suit.
To take to oneself; to claim or use, especially as by an exclusive right.
defs.ex: Let no man appropriate the use of a common benefit.

defs.d: Suitable or fit; proper.
defs.ex: The headmaster wondered what an appropriate measure would be to make the pupil behave better.

defs.d: Suitable to the social situation or to social respect or social discreetness; socially correct; socially discreet; well-mannered; proper.
defs.ex: I don't think it was appropriate for the cashier to tell me out loud in front of all those people at the check-out that my hair-piece looked like it was falling out of place.

defs.d: A structure that bars passage.
An obstacle or impediment.
To block or obstruct with a barrier.
A virtual member function of a class.
In effect or essence, if not in fact or reality; imitated, simulated.
defs.ex: In fact a defeat on the battlefield, Tet was a virtual victory for the North, owing to its effect on public opinion.

defs.d: Having the power of acting or of invisible efficacy without the agency of the material or measurable part; potential.
A person who is suspected of something, in particular of committing a crime.
To imagine or suppose (something) to be true, or to exist, without proof.
defs.ex: to suspect the presence of disease

defs.d: To distrust or have doubts about (something or someone).
defs.ex: to suspect the truth of a story

defs.d: Viewed with suspicion; suspected.
Viewing with suspicion; suspecting.
